definitions.full: H4096. midrak [ מִדְרָךְ ] noun [masculine] treading- or stepping-place , place for the foot to tread on, only construct כַּףרָֿ֑גֶל מִדְרַךְ Deut 2:5 a treading-place for the sole of a foot (compare 11:24 = Josh 1:3 ).
